question: Can any no-intercept nonnegative clock using just the selected counters cover every observed held-out case within 20%?
population: All ordered pairs of different held-out programs across all recorded input sizes. Exclude training programs and warmups.
method: For slower A and faster B, upper-bound the ratio of any weighted counter sums by the largest max(A_feature)/min(B_feature) across the two metered observations. Skip a pair if a positive numerator has a zero denominator. Ignore columns zero on both sides. Use the minimum native time of A and maximum native time of B across the seven timed runs. Use the existing pair_bound calculation, including the one nanosecond allowance for final rounding.
selection: Publish the strongest positive lower bound per model. Break ties by lexicographic order of the ordered case identifiers. A bound exceeding 20% falsifies the target even after allowing each case its entire observed native timing range. Failure to find a witness is inconclusive.
